scope: Offline engineering plus camera-only recording; no new motor execution or policy deployment.

implemented: Distinct capture evidence for strike alignment; command lifetime clipped to the shared 350 ms observation deadline
Strike footprint/remaining-travel envelope with configurable uncalibrated stopping allowance
Independent per-robot tactical role/guard generator; not yet automatic live scheduling
Camera gate with overlap/freshness/hysteresis and per-robot executor cancellation; scheduler gap cannot revive strike
Original camera timestamps survive queued inference; future frames cannot poison the source highwater; detection uses a fixed 220-degree projection
limitations: All new runtime changes remain undeployed
Guard pose heading can still be replaced with travel heading during distant pose navigation
Camera health needs source-image quality metadata; empty detections alone are insufficient
Live movement profile and stopping distance remain uncalibrated

camera.operator_sequence: On ground: person approximately 1 m, then 1.5 m, then 0.5 m; crossing at approximately 1 m; tall object moved forward/back. Camera cover not reported.
camera.root_visual_review: Root personally inspected raw contact sheets, enlarged frames and approximate same-time detector overlays. Person approach/crossing is visible. The tower-shaped object clearly occupies the forward path but is largely missed. Two bottle-class detections near +105.49/+105.80 seconds correspond spatially to it; coverage is intermittent.
camera.replay_limit: Historical detections use publication time instead of source capture time. Spatial-only replay cannot establish end-to-end latency. The 0.62/0.60 threshold candidate is fitted to one clip and not independently validated. The person behind the moved object can mask obstacle failure.

camera_thinking.decision: eligible for separately authorized bounded motion, provided camera health and other guards pass

camera_thinking.decision: hold; preserve role but cancel action progress; require sustained clear observations before fresh-plan resume

camera_thinking.decision: should hold; current detector-only input cannot guarantee this

policy_evaluation.conclusion: Keep the stock baseline. Alternatives improve lateral tracking but worsen braking, yaw or clipping. The fourth Markus replica rotates approximately 42 degrees after combined motion changes to zero in nominal simulation. Six-foot lateral paths show cross-axis drift.
policy_evaluation.scope: Nominal CPU simulation includes production HeadingHold; not full ROS, actual sensors/actuators or field XY feedback.
